description: This Java source file defines the class CreatePolicyStrategy, which handles the CreatePolicy command for managing policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class constructs new Policy objects, validates them, and produces results based on the commands it processes.

classes.name: CreatePolicyStrategy
classes.description: A class that handles the CreatePolicy command by creating, validating, and emitting events for new policies.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic: creates a new policy, sets default lifecycle, validates, and returns a result with the created policy event.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag based on the existing policy, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the newly created policy.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates whether the command is defined in the given context; always returns true for this implementation.
